text:
Max (Sales): quick sync — AcmeHealth asking for a 3-week POC. Need final prioritized use cases, endpoints, success criteria, and any security blockers we should flag to them. also price sensitivity: they asked if Dedicated vs Hosted changes SLA and cost materially

Oliver (Solutions): high-level suggestion: 1) Claims triage (classify incoming claim type + extract fields) 2) PII redaction + PHI detection for storage 3) Conversational agent for claims status (templated replies) — prioritize 1 then 3 then 2 for MVP.

Max (Sales): good. can you add concrete endpoints + example prompts for each?

Oliver (Solutions): yes — endpoints and evals below:

- /v1/claims/extract (POST)
  - Input: claim text PDF->OCR as text (we'll ask for a small sample set)
  - Output: JSON with fields: claimant_name, dob, member_id, procedure_codes[], amounts
  - Prompt (system): "Extract ICD/CPT codes, patient identifiers, date-of-service, billed amount. Return only JSON fields."
  - Eval metric: exact-match on required fields (EM%) and slot F1. Target: EM >= 88% on required fields, slot F1 >= 92%.

- /v1/claims/classify (POST)
  - Input: claim text
  - Output: category (inpatient/outpatient/ER/other) + confidence score
  - Prompt example: "Classify claim into one of: inpatient, outpatient, emergency, lab, pharmacy, other. Return JSON {\"category\":..., \"confidence\":0.0}."
  - Eval metric: accuracy >= 90% on labeled sample set. Latency target: p50 < 120ms for hosted; p50 < 80ms on Dedicated if quantized.

- /v1/claims/status-chat (streaming)
  - Input: user message + claim id context
  - Output: short templated reply or escalation flag
  - Prompt: see snippet below. Metric: NPS-style satisfaction proxy from manual eval + automated template F1. Target: 85% helpfulness on pilot prompts.

Sample prompt snippet for status-chat:
```
SYSTEM: You are an assistant that only uses the provided claim metadata. If the answer requires PHI, ask to escalate. Use short templated replies.
USER: "What's the status of claim 12345?"
ASSISTANT: "Claim 12345 is in review by adjudications team (ETA 2 business days)."
```

Sara (PM): acceptance criteria (POC pass/fail) proposal:
- Functional: claims extraction EM >= 88% on the 200-sample test set provided; classification accuracy >= 90%.
- Performance: 95th pct latency < 500ms for single-shot extract; throughput >= 30 requests/sec on Dedicated baseline OR cost per 1k extracts < $X on Hosted (we'll give rough numbers in follow-up).
- Safety / Compliance: no PHI returned in open-chat flows; redaction passes manual audit for 50 sampled items.
- Integration: 2 endpoints integrated into their staging pipeline, SSO + API key validation working.

Jia (Security): security blockers to flag to AcmeHealth:
- They require data residency in eu-west-1 and SOC2 + HIPAA. Confirm whether they need a Private deployment (VPC + customer KMS). If they demand an HSM-backed KMS, that pushes to Private/Enterprise.
- Questionnaire request: encryption-at-rest, key rotation policy, log retention, who has access to raw logs. We'll need their security contact to answer detailed questionnaire.
- For POC: recommend hashing/anonymizing PHIs before we receive them unless using Private.

Nate (SRE): infra notes:
- If they want low p50 latency and high throughput for extraction we'll recommend Dedicated with quantized weights and batch size tuned.
- Canary plan: start 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100% with automatic fallback to smaller model / different region.
- Observability: we need request-id propagated and token-level cost breakdown enabled. We'll put tracing hooks in the /v1/claims/* routes.

Ben (Support): operational asks:
- Need sample dataset (200 annotated claims), S3 read-only bucket or staging endpoints with test keys.
- Contact from their infosec for the questionnaire.
- Whitelist IPs or allow API key header from their staging env.

Max (Sales): pricing question they asked: "How much more is Dedicated?" — can we give a ballpark for a 3-week POC with reserved capacity for 2 GPUs vs hosted? Also need to call out that Dedicated gives tighter latency p50 and deterministic billing.

Oliver (Solutions): ballpark: for a short POC, Dedicated (2x A10G-equivalent) reserved for 3 weeks + network = ~$12k-$18k (depends on region, infra). Hosted estimate for same volume (no reservation) likely $3k-$7k in per-token costs for the test workload. Emphasize: Dedicated reduces p50 by ~30-50% in our bench and gives isolation for PHI. Exact quote from salesops.

Sara (PM): timeline proposal (3 weeks):
- Week 0 (this week): confirm scope, security contacts, sample data access. Owners: Max (sales) to get security contact, Ben to get data path.
- Week 1: model integration + endpoints up, initial smoke tests. Owners: Oliver + Nate.
- Week 2: run evals, iterate prompts, redaction checks, begin 10% canary. Owners: Oliver, Sara.
- Week 3: finalize metrics, bug fixes, handover to Acme for staging. Decision checkpoint end of Week 3: Pass/Fail based on acceptance criteria.

Jia (Security): add to timeline: security questionnaire returned within 3 business days of receiving it; if they need Private, add 1 week for networking and KMS config.

deploy-bot: created ticket RED-POC-4521 for "AcmeHealth POC - infra setup & security questionnaire" <https://work.mgmt/RED-POC-4521>

Max (Sales): thanks everyone. Oliver can you draft a one-page POC scope doc (use cases, endpoints, acceptance criteria, rough cost range) and I'll send to Acme today? If possible, include the sample prompt + evaluation checklist.

Oliver (Solutions): will do and attach to the ticket by EOD. tagging @Sara (PM) for acceptance criteria review. :thumbsup:
